dashboards.after: Fresh-install onboarding analysis anchored on first onboarding_started where cohort=fresh_install, grouped by PostHog distinct_id as install identity. staged_insights.description: Anchor = first onboarding_started fresh_install on a supporting build, opt-outs excluded, full 24h+15m follow-up. Interaction = first_agent_interaction install_cohort=fresh: observed prompt/message submission, not provider success or agent launch. unattributed_prompt (may be automation) shown separately. Workspace = create, default checkout opened, or any repo_added with is_git_repo=false within the activation window; this is distinct from the onboarding repair's legacy/first-repo git/folder classification.

staged_insights.description: Same definition as the 24h tile with a 7d window and full 7d+15m follow-up. install_cohort_mismatch counts fresh anchors whose first interaction is tagged existing (e.g. onboarding restarted after upgrade); they are not activations. Supporting builds are observed from data, not a hard-coded release.

staged_insights.name: Fresh-install launch return vs explicit-activity return by platform (D1, D3, D7, 2-week, 30-day window)
staged_insights.description: Same fresh-install cohort and complete-follow-up denominators. Explicit = meaningful_activity_day (desktop/mobile-chat actions; misses phone-terminal and paired remote-runtime-only days, so not complete retention); launch = app_opened. UTC days after anchor day; D3/D7 = return by that day. NULL until eligible. Legacy any-event tiles stay as history; do not join lines.
